verdict.rationale: Column's docs explicitly cover domestic wires (Fedwire) and RTP/FedNow send, receive, and RFP through the same unified API, with a dedicated realtime.md page detailing per-rail capabilities, plus a unified transfers query endpoint and sandbox simulation support. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of FedNow/RTP behavior in production (community evidence only covers ACH/cards/checks, not real-time rails) and more granular per-rail limits/cutoff documentation.
